title: King's Kamp RV Park and Marina

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Our Recreational Vehicle sites are right on the open water of Florida Bay and located adjacent to the Marina for easy access to your boat. The waterfront location provides spectacular views. The sites are easy, pull up access sites for Recreational Vehicles up to 40 feet in length. All Sites offer FULL hookup, 75 channels of free cable TV and free Wi-Fi is always available. Those renters who trailer boats can be easily accommodated in our Marina. The kamp also has motel rooms and apartments for extra guest accommodations. Pets are allowed, but restrictions apply. Please check with management before bringing your pet. ALL reservations are accepted 18 months prior to check in date. Advanced

addons.name: Advanced deposits for stays 1 month or more
